hebrewText: וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶֽת נַעֲר/וֹ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁלְחוּ נָ֥א אֶת זֹ֛את מֵ/עָלַ֖/י הַ/ח֑וּצָ/ה וּ/נְעֹ֥ל הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽי/הָ

tokens.bdb: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
tokens.explanation: qara — chamar, nomear, convocar, proclamar, invocar

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
tokens.kjv: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).

tokens.bdb: to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively

tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
tokens.explanation: shalach — enviar, mandar, despachar, estender a mão

tokens.bdb: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
tokens.kjv: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.kjv: hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: properly, separate by awall, i.e. outside, outdoors
tokens.kjv: abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out(-side, -ward), street, without.

tokens.bdb: properly, to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers
tokens.kjv: bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.

tokens.bdb: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
tokens.explanation: achar — depois, após, atrás, em seguida
